description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'SaveQualificationLanguageController' within the OrangeHRM system. The class extends an abstract Vue controller and manages the pre-rendering setup by configuring Vue components based on whether an 'id' attribute is present in the HTTP request. Its primary purpose is to facilitate saving or editing qualification language data within the HR management system.

classes.name: SaveQualificationLanguageController
classes.description: A controller that manages the setup of Vue components for saving or editing qualification languages, depending on whether an 'id' attribute exists in the incoming request.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component to be rendered, selecting between 'qualification-language-edit' and 'qualification-language-save' based on the presence of an 'id' parameter in the request.
